title: HolyPackage
description: Adds rare package for each holycube member.
body:
Adds a rare package for each Holycube member, that's it!

This mod is a custom mod made for the Holycube Revolution modpack.
I let you discover all the rare package variants by yourself. It adds the 51 members of the current season, plus 3 other rare packages, including the HC package below.
If you dislike the texture or the ID of a package, please open an issue on GitHub with the label "request changes."

![Little leak.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9d9ee26feb5b17fe0936f971f13043930349874_0.webp)

The code was made by Iglée42 and Arp_sys.
The textures were made by Arp_sys.
Original idea by The_Smitties.
Thanks to Iglée42 for the help.

Feel free to reuse the source code to make your own rare custom packages.

This mod was posted on CurseForge and Modrinth. Download from there if you want to support me.
